title: EvoSurv: Evolution-Aware Multimodal Survival Modeling Reveals Complementary Prognostic Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.13190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. translated_title: EvoSurv：进化感知的多模态生存建模揭示互补的预后信号
translated_abstract: 由于肿瘤异质性的存在，准确的癌症生存预测仍然充满挑战。尽管多模态生存模型已经整合了临床与分子数据，但它们往往忽略了基因组改变中所编码的进化信息。为填补这一空白，我们开发了eTime，这是一种38维的进化特征表示，由八个特征组构成，用于刻画克隆与亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能性后果、拷贝数改变以及失巢凋亡相关的基因组变化。我们进一步构建了EvoSurv，一个将eTime与临床变量和RNA表达相整合的多模态生存预测框架。在包含2,782名患者的六个TCGA癌症队列中，EvoSurv在全部六种癌症中均取得了最高的平均一致性指数（C-index），平均值为0.663，优于三种最先进的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了进化特征能否提供额外的预后价值……
tldr: 该研究提出了eTime进化特征表示和EvoSurv多模态生存预测框架，将肿瘤基因组进化信息（克隆结构、突变谱、拷贝数改变等）与临床数据和RNA表达相结合，在六个TCGA癌症队列中全面超越现有最先进方法，揭示了肿瘤进化中蕴含的互补预后信号。
en_tdlr: EvoSurv integrates a novel 38-dimensional evolutionary representation (eTime) capturing clonal architecture, mutational spectra, and copy-number alterations with clinical variables and RNA expression, achieving superior survival prediction across six TCGA cancer cohorts and revealing complementary prognostic signals encoded in tumor evolution.
